author: KEXP
description: Shoegaze renegades Nothing breathe fuzz and reverb into the genre on their fifth studio album 'a short history of decay.' The Philly-based outfit share a performance of "cannibal world" and more in our latest in-studio session.
title: Nothing performs "cannibal world" & more Live on KEXP
